Unverified missing-module reconstruction; adapted intact Boost binding 55e6516eb91b739e899df1ef8d72116da44fec49:GameScript.cpp to original #260-268 no-argument callbacks and CMap/CMapObject/CBuilding/CItem/CInteraction/CTile/CScriptEngine APIs; Creature/Player/Monster API from intact #247 headers with source-era C-prefix renames; Stats/Damage typed-property API from intact #257 Stats.h/cpp. Preserves Python2.7 BOOST_PYTHON_MODULE(_game) -> init_game; UTF8 QString conversion supports Python2 str/unicode. CPotion wrapper deduces the native void/bool onUse return type across original #266 transition and always calls the real fallback. Native #266 compilation exposed Boost1.58 extract(method_result) ambiguity; PythonPotionCall now uses the genuine method_result::as<Result>() typed conversion, while void specialization still invokes the callback directly. Shared callback conversion compiled at both native #260 (void onUse) and #266 (bool onUse), and gcc-nm-5 verified init_game under sealed image sha256:d3f59ec1d12297ee8091fbea687aa619275fc92b3fd426560e0a1fa40715afc8. This proves object compilation for the d59b1fb1 payload only; no link/startup or earlier-blob native acceptance. Native #260 runtime exposed original scripts/game/interaction.py importing Interaction and calling Stats.getDamage; export an alias of the real CInteraction binding and bind the genuine Stats::getDamage method. No fake type or no-op binding; exact init_game/Python2.7 ABI retained.
